name: Pilot Reports Ship Escape and Facility Explosion
description: A pilot's voice crackled over the radio, breathless and urgent. 'Repeat, that was not us! A ship escaped—must've blown the place themselves!' A sharp pause followed, then a low, disbelieving whisper. 'Jesus... a lot of our guys were still down there.'
related_events: Pilot reports ship escape and explosion over radio

name: Cab and Container Merge onto Sunken Highway
description: The cab and container, moving under digital control, roll out of the loading area and onto a cloverleaf access ramp. In the near-darkness, with no headlights, the vehicle descends toward a sunken highway and merges into a steady stream of fast-moving traffic. Unlit vehicles glide close together at high speed through the reddish haze, and the cab blends into the flow, continuing forward on the darkened roadway.
related_events: Digitally controlled cab and container exit loading area onto access ramp
Vehicle merges onto high-speed sunken highway in near-darkness

name: Underground Explosion and Collapse
description: The ground heaved upward as an immense subterranean blast tore through the earth. Within moments, the swollen terrain cracked and gave way, collapsing in on itself. Jets of flame, smoke, and dirt erupted violently into the air, rising from the fractured ground in thick, churning columns.
related_events: Subterranean blast causes ground to swell and collapse
Jets of flame, smoke, and dirt rise after the blast

name: Marcus Wright Rises from the Mud and Screams
description: The ground stirs in a patch of mud, bubbling as a figure begins to emerge. Rain falls steadily, soaking the lifeless cornfield. The figure rises, naked and drenched in thick mud, its shape slowly becoming human as the downpour washes away the clinging earth. Water streams down the face, revealing Marcus Wright. His eyes open wide, darting in confusion. He tilts his head to the sky, opens his mouth, and lets out a raw, guttural scream.
related_events: Marcus Wright emerges from mud-covered hibernation
Marcus Wright screams after regaining consciousness

name: Soldiers Attack Electronics Room
description: The soldiers burst into a room filled with industrial robots and banks of electronics. Helmet beams swept across the space as the soldiers opened fire. Bullets struck the machinery, sending sparks flying. Mechanical arms jerked and stilled as circuitry exploded and equipment collapsed in smoking wreckage. The robots, engaged in their tasks moments before, lay destroyed or in pieces across the floor.
related_events: Soldiers open fire on industrial robots and machinery
Machinery collapses and circuitry explodes from gunfire damage
Industrial robots perform automated tasks in electronics room

name: Breach and Clear
description: A heavy door blew off its hinges, clattering across the floor inside the complex. The team leader stepped forward, scanned the room, and called out, 'Clear!' The soldiers rose from cover and moved quickly through the shattered doorway, advancing deeper into the structure.
related_events: Heavy door blows off its hinges
Team leader declares area clear
Soldiers move through blown door

name: Marcus Escapes the Hydrobots
description: Marcus breaks the surface of the water, staggering toward the shore and collapsing to his knees in the shallows. Behind him, wakes ripple across the river. He turns and sees dark shapes moving swiftly through the water from multiple directions, flashes of metal glinting beneath the surface. Without hesitation, he scrambles up the riverbank and vanishes into the leafless trees.
related_events: Marcus emerges from water and staggers to shore
Hydrobots approach Marcus in the river
Marcus flees from hydrobots into the trees

name: Team Leader Finds Brain Before Sudden Quake
description: The team leader shines his headlamp into a glass cylinder filled with translucent pink liquid. Inside, a human brain floats, connected to a dense network of fiber-optic cables. He recoils in horror. Before he can speak, a deafening roar rips through the room. The walls shudder violently as the floor trembles beneath them.
related_events: Team leader discovers human brain in pink liquid-filled cylinder
Room shakes from deafening roar

name: Kyle Announces Arrival After Landing
description: The transport vehicle touches down, jolting the prisoners inside the steel container. In the darkness, Kyle and Star sit among the others, Star still wearing her baseball cap. As the vehicle settles, Kyle speaks: "We've landed."
related_events: Transport vehicle touches down at destination
Prisoners experience jostling during landing
Kyle announces arrival after landing

name: Escort Marcus to Execution
description: Guards lead Marcus down a dimly lit prison corridor, his ankles chained, the clank of metal echoing with each step. Prisoners watch from their cells—some turning away, others raising a fist in silent solidarity. A priest walks beside him, speaking of a final chance to confess, asking if Marcus has any words for Officer Martinez' family. Marcus stares ahead, his breaths slow and steady, his silence unbroken.
related_events: Guards lead Marcus down prison corridor
Priest offers Marcus final opportunity to confess
Marcus remains silent in response to priest's appeal

name: Marcus climbs a rise and sees a ruined city
description: Bare feet trudge through the dirt. Marcus moves along a slight rise, wrapped in torn and filthy rags, mud caked on his body. The air is still, the silence unbroken. Reaching the edge of the rise, he looks out and sees a decimated city in the distance—buildings collapsed into rubble, stretching across the horizon.
related_events: Marcus traverses muddy terrain toward a rise
Marcus discovers a decimated city in the distance

name: Team Discovers Horrifying Find in Facility
description: The team leader speaks into his headset, his voice tense. Around him, soldiers move between rows of cylinders, their faces twisting in horror as they inspect the contents. One by one, they step back, stunned. As the team leader begins to report, a green LED light on the ceiling abruptly flashes red, blinking rapidly, filling the room with an urgent, pulsing glow.
related_events: Soldiers inspect cylinders and react with horror
Team leader reports shocking discovery via headset
Green LED on ceiling changes to flashing red alert

name: Marcus Finds Whisky and Collapses in the Ruined Bar
description: Marcus moves through the wreckage of a collapsed bar, illuminating the debris with a flickering lighter. He searches behind the broken counter, shifting aside rubble and shattered glass until he uncovers a dusty bottle of whisky. He twists off the cap, holds the bottle toward a skeleton lying nearby in a silent toast, and takes a long drink. Almost instantly, he gags, sways, and collapses to the floor, unconscious.
related_events: Marcus finds a dusty bottle of whisky behind the bar
Marcus drinks from the dusty whisky bottle and passes out

name: Troops Fire on Rising Escape Ship
description: A massive escape ship rises vertically from an open hatchway. Nearby troops crouch and open fire as the ship ascends. It pivots in mid-air and roars away at high speed. Soldiers on the ground duck and scramble to avoid the intense engine blast as the vessel departs.
related_events: Escape ship ascends from hatchway
Troops open fire on ascending escape ship
Escape ship pivots and departs at high speed
Soldiers dodge engine blast from departing ship

name: Carrying Unconscious Marcus Through the Corridor
description: Barnes, Morrison, Nancy, and Lisa carry the unconscious Marcus down a narrow corridor after emerging from an open trap door. Blair follows close behind, bleeding from shrapnel wounds, helping as she can. As they move, Blair shouts at Barnes, calling him a goddamn idiot. Morrison grunts under the strain, muttering that Marcus is heavy.
related_events: Barnes, Morrison, and others carry unconscious Marcus through corridor
Blair assists while bleeding from shrapnel injuries
Blair yells at Barnes during evacuation
Morrison complains about Marcus's weight during carry

name: Container Deployment and Cab Attachment
description: The transport descends through the reddish haze and comes to rest among scattered containers, cranes, and vehicles. From its frame, the flying framework and armature disengage and lift off into the dim air, leaving behind the trailer-like wheeled container. Moments later, a truck cab reverses steadily into position and connects to the attachment points on the container, locking it into place.
related_events: Transport lands among containers, cranes, and vehicles under reddish haze
Flying framework and armature detach from transport and take off
Truck cab backs into position and latches onto container

name: Soldiers Help Wounded Reach Evacuation Helicopters
description: Soldiers on the ground guide the wounded toward waiting helicopters. They move through the open area, supporting the injured as rotor blades spin overhead. One soldier crouches in the foreground, retrieving the steel skull of a destroyed Terminator. The scene shifts as the choppers lift off.
related_events: Soldiers assist wounded in evacuation to helicopters

name: Find the Terminator's Steel Skull
description: Soldiers move among the wounded, helping them toward evacuation helicopters. In the foreground, one of them stops and crouches down, uncovering the steel skull of a dead Terminator from the debris. The skull lies exposed, its eye sockets dark, jaw slightly open, a remnant of the battle that took place.
related_events: Discovery of Terminator's steel skull in foreground

name: Marcus Finds New Clothes in a Ruined Store
description: In the dim glow of a cigarette lighter, Marcus moves through a room cluttered with dust and debris. He kicks aside fallen ceiling tiles, revealing a rack of army jackets beneath. He pulls one out, holding it up to inspect it in the flickering light. Satisfied, he sets it aside and rummages through scattered clothing, retrieving a pair of jeans and sneakers. He strips off his tattered rags and pulls on the new clothes, fitting them on with care.
related_events: Marcus uses cigarette lighter for illumination
Marcus finds and changes into jeans and sneakers
Marcus clears fallen ceiling tiles from rack of army jackets
Marcus inspects an army jacket

name: Marcus Takes the Woman's Face from the Advertisement
description: Marcus walks through the outskirts of a dead city and stops near a collapsed bus kiosk. A faded advertisement on the kiosk shows a smiling woman. He looks at her face, reaches out, and runs his hand over the image. He pulls away a broken piece of graffitied glass covering the poster, then carefully tears the paper to remove the woman's face. He folds the paper and slips it into his pocket before walking on.
related_events: Marcus pauses near collapsed bus kiosk in dead city outskirts
Marcus studies smiling woman in faded advertisement
Marcus touches advertisement and removes chunk of cracked glass
Marcus tears poster to extract woman's face and pockets it

name: The Execution of Marcus
description: A needle punctures Marcus' forearm, the IV line already in place. A valve turns, releasing a stream of lethal chemicals into the tube. The fluid travels upward, descending into his arm. Marcus lies still, his eyes lifting toward the bright lights above. The world blurs, the light bleaching everything to white. In the glare, a face appears—Serena—her features sharp for a moment before she leans in and passes out of view. Darkness follows.
related_events: Needle punctures Marcus' skin during injection
Lethal chemicals are released through IV valve

name: Marcus's Final Vision
description: The lethal injection takes hold as Marcus lies on the gurney, his eyes lifting toward the one-way mirror. He sees his own reflection, faint and distorted, with the dim outlines of witnesses behind the glass. His gaze drifts upward to the bright lights overhead, their edges blurring, fading into a wash of white. From the blankness, a face emerges—Serena’s—backlit and hazy, coming briefly into focus before she leans in and then moves out of view. The screen goes black.
related_events: Lethal injection takes effect on Marcus
Marcus observes his reflection in one-way mirror
Marcus hallucinates Serena's face emerging from white screen

name: Marcus, Kyle, and Star Observe the Drone's Pattern
description: Marcus, Kyle, and Star rise from behind a dumpster in the cracked parking lot near the abandoned fast-food joint. Kyle raises binoculars and scans the building, focusing on the area around the broken windows and collapsed sign. Star holds up a watch, her eyes fixed on its face, tracking the passage of time. A small steel aerostat hovers nearby, its red-lit camera scanning in precise movements before vanishing around the corner of the building toward the motel. The three drop back down behind the dumpster, crouched out of sight.
related_events: Marcus, Kyle and Star emerge from hiding behind a dumpster
Kyle observes the fast-food place with binoculars
Star checks the time on her watch
Marcus, Kyle and Star retreat back into hiding

name: Star, Kyle, and Marcus Rush to Enter the Fast-Food Joint
description: Star checks her watch, then signals sharply. Kyle and Star sprint toward the entrance of the fast-food joint, their movements quick and low. Marcus follows close behind. They reach the doorway and slip inside just as the aerostat vanishes around the corner of the building.
related_events: Star signals and leads the group's dash toward the fast-food entrance
Marcus, Kyle and Star rush into the fast-food joint entrance

name: Jane Discovers Marcus Is a Machine
description: Marcus is laid on a metal table in a crude medical area surrounded by infants and toddlers. Doctor Jane approaches with scissors and other tools, cutting away the tattered remains of his pants and sneaker. She examines his blackened leg, pressing on it briefly, then picks up a scalpel and draws it across the charred skin. The blade leaves no mark. Startled, she asks if Marcus stepped on a Claymore, wondering how he could have survived. She turns to Blair, questioning whether Marcus has a prosthetic limb. He says no. Jane cuts open Marcus’s torn shirt and runs the scalpel across his chest. Again, the skin does not cut. She steps back, her expression shifting to horror. She looks at Morrison and whispers, 'He's a terminator.'
related_events: Jane examines Marcus's blackened leg after amputating clothing
Jane tests Marcus's skin with a scalpel on his leg and chest
Jane identifies Marcus as a terminator

name: Marcus's Artificial Body Revealed in Memory Flash
description: A series of fragmented images flashes by, accompanied by sharp digital static. A robotic hand, stripped of flesh, flexes its metal fingers into a tight fist. The camera moves around a muscular male torso made of synthetic material, its limbs and head absent, with metallic joints exposed and ready for attachment. In another image, a thin, lifelike face membrane drifts downward through a fluid-filled chamber, descending toward the viewer. Through one of the eyeholes in the membrane, Serena’s distorted face is visible. Her voice comes through, muffled and urgent: 'Why isn't he conscious? Something's wrong, he should be coming out of it by now...'
related_events: robotic hand framework flexes into a fist
artificial face membrane lowers toward camera through liquid
Serena expresses concern about Marcus's unconscious state

name: Blair Stands by the Entity Amid Outpost Tensions
description: Blair stands in the outpost common area, facing a group of residents gathered around a battered dining table. He insists the entity saved his life, his voice rising in defense. Morrison challenges him, arguing that the act of saving him could be part of a larger plan to gain trust. Nancy steps forward, trembling with anger, pointing at X-rays spread across the table. She demands to know how Blair could bring such a thing into their home, shouting about the safety of their children. Around them, the walls are lined with cracked posters of military aircraft and rockets, alongside faded children’s drawings. At the communications station, Lisa speaks into a shortwave radio, headset pressed to her ears, announcing that Regional is patching them through to Command in Los Angeles. Before anyone can respond, a child bursts into the room and shouts, 'It's awake!'
related_events: Blair defends the unknown entity to the residents
Morrison expresses suspicion about the entity's intentions
Nancy confronts Blair about bringing the entity to the outpost

name: Lisa Contacts Command for Guidance
description: Lisa wears a headset at the communications area near the TVs, speaking into a shortwave radio. She calls out to the others, saying that regional command doesn't know what to do and will patch them through to Command Los Angeles. Around her, residents gather at a battered dining table, their voices tense and uneasy as they wait for answers.
related_events: Lisa communicates with regional command via shortwave radio

name: The Entity Awakens
description: At the outpost, voices rose among the residents gathered around Blair, tensions flaring over the X-rays spread across the table. Jane held up the image of the skull, its interior obscured by lead shielding. Morrison challenged Blair’s trust in the being, while Nancy accused him of endangering their home. Lisa leaned into the shortwave radio, waiting for a response from Command Los Angeles. In the midst of the argument, the door burst open. A child ran into the room, breathless, and shouted: 'It's awake!' The room fell silent. All eyes turned toward the corridor.
related_events: Child announces that the entity has awakened

name: Marcus and Blair Enter the Garden
description: Marcus trudges through low brush, his foot nearly landing on a watermelon half-buried in the undergrowth. He stops short, spotting a strand of barbed wire emerging from the dirt nearby. Blair halts a few feet ahead, eyes widening as he takes in the surroundings. 'Christ... there's supposed to be barbed wire along the edge,' he says. Marcus turns, scanning the area, and points. A few yards away, more barbed wire stretches ahead and behind them, revealing they’ve walked through a gap where the fence had collapsed. 'Whatever you do, don't move,' Blair says sharply. He shouts into the distance, 'Yo! Morrison, Barnes! Can anybody hear me?!' Turning to Marcus, he lowers his voice. 'We're in the middle of the mine field.'
related_events: Marcus notices barbed wire and nearly steps on watermelon
Blair reacts to realization they are in a garden with barbed wire

name: Marcus and Blair Discover the Encircling Barbed Wire
description: Marcus points toward a stretch of barbed wire a few yards ahead. The camera shifts to show more strands of wire running not only in front but also behind them, partially buried and tangled in the undergrowth. It becomes clear they have walked through a gap where the fence had collapsed. They stand surrounded, the wire forming a loose but continuous barrier on all sides.
related_events: Marcus points out barbed wire ahead
Camera reveals barbed wire surrounds the area

name: Blair and Marcus in the Mine Field
description: Blair stops suddenly and tells Marcus not to move. He shouts out for Morrison and Barnes, calling to see if anyone can hear them. Then he turns to Marcus and says they are in the middle of a mine field.
related_events: Blair warns Marcus not to move and shouts for help
Blair realizes they are in a mine field

name: Aerostats Deploy in Transport Cabin
description: A small panel slides open at the front of the transport, and six processing aerostats buzz inside from the cab. These floating devices are larger than spy drones and equipped with pincers capable of encircling a person's arm. Prisoners flinch and try to dodge, but the aerostats move quickly from one captive to the next, latching onto their arms. Screams fill the air as flashes of light burst from the devices. One aerostat seizes Kyle’s forearm with its pincers, emitting a sizzling sound. Kyle cries out in pain as a red flash flares, then the device detaches and flies to its next target. Another aerostat approaches Star, latches onto her wrist, and delivers the same searing shock. She stumbles to Kyle’s side, tears in her eyes, sucking on her burned wrist. Both look down at the fresh barcodes now seared into their skin.
related_events: Processing aerostats deploy into transport cabin
Prisoners attempt to evade processing aerostats

name: Kyle is branded with a bar code by a processing aerostat
description: A processing aerostat buzzes toward Kyle and clamps its pincers around his forearm. A sizzling sound fills the air as a flash of red light flares, and Kyle cries out in pain. The device releases him and moves away. He looks down at his arm, where a fresh bar code has been seared into his skin.
related_events: Aerostat attaches pincers to Kyle's forearm
Kyle experiences pain from aerostat processing
Kyle discovers a fresh bar code seared into his arm

name: Star Endures Aerostat Processing and Seeks Comfort from Kyle
description: A processing aerostat buzzes toward Star, its pincers clamping onto her arm. A flash of light and a sizzling sound follow as she cries out in pain. The aerostat detaches and moves away, leaving a burn on her wrist. Tears in her eyes, Star sucks on the injured wrist and steps to Kyle's side. She looks at him, voice trembling, and asks what is going to happen to them.
related_events: Star undergoes aerostat processing
Star expresses fear about their fate to Kyle

name: Marcus Awakens in the Missile Silo
description: Marcus opens his eyes, a sharp beam of sunlight cutting across his face. He is suspended upside-down from a winch, a thick steel cable running through his body. He twists slightly, feeling the cold metal embedded in his calves and forearms—steel bolts drilled through his limbs, locking them in place. Above, the sunlight streams through a narrow gap between massive steel panels set into the silo’s ceiling. He turns his head downward, peering into the dark, bottomless pit beneath him. The walls of the abandoned missile silo rise around him, lined with rusted scaffolding and scattered tool carts. A group of children stands at the edge, silent and watching. Nearby, Barnes sits in a folding chair, an RPG resting across his lap. One of the children nudges him, and Barnes jolts awake, immediately raising the weapon and aiming it at Marcus.
related_events: Marcus awakens while suspended upside-down from a winch
Marcus observes a beam of sunlight through sliding steel panels above
Marcus discovers steel cables drilled through his calves and forearms
Marcus looks down into the dark depths of an abandoned missile silo

name: Children Alert Barnes as Marcus Wakes
description: Small children stand near scaffolding at the edge of the silo pit, staring down into the darkness. Barnes sits in a folding chair, leaning back with his eyes closed, an RPG resting across his lap. One of the children reaches out and taps his leg. Barnes jerks upright, snaps awake, and immediately raises the RPG, aiming it at Marcus.
related_events: Small children gather near scaffolding to stare into the silo pit
Barnes rests in a folding chair with an RPG in his lap
One of the children taps Barnes' leg to get his attention
Barnes jerks upright and trains his weapon on Marcus

name: Marcus Startles Barnes with a Sudden 'Boo!'
description: Marcus hangs upside down, suspended by steel cables driven through his calves and forearms. Sunlight cuts through a narrow gap above, illuminating the interior of the abandoned missile silo. Children gather near the edge, watching silently. Barnes sits in a folding chair, an RPG resting in his lap, eyes closed. A child taps his leg, and Barnes jolts upright, immediately swinging the weapon toward Marcus. The two lock eyes. Marcus stares, expressionless. Then, without warning, he says, 'Boo!'
related_events: Marcus stares at Barnes with a deadpan expression
Marcus startles Barnes by exclaiming 'Boo!'

name: Aerial Assault on the Cornfield
description: A bunker-busting missile slams into the cornfield, erupting in a massive explosion that tears through the earth and flings debris into the air. Several figures are obliterated, and a Terminator's scorched body, its metal skull split open and red eyes shattered, crashes to the ground face up. Moments later, A-10 Warthogs roar overhead, unleashing cannon fire that rakes the remaining figures, tearing them apart. The stubby attack planes veer away, trailing smoke as they drop napalm in the distance, igniting a wall of fire behind the advancing soldiers.
related_events: Bunker-busting missile strikes cornfield and detonates
Explosion hurls Terminator body into foreground
A-10 Warthogs attack remaining figures with cannon fire
A-10 Warthogs lay napalm behind advancing soldiers

name: Resistance Troops Land and Advance on Breached Bunker
description: After the explosion, a fleet of helicopters touches down in the cornfield, rotors whipping up smoke and debris. The choppers disgorge Resistance soldiers wearing high-tech helmets and carrying futuristic assault weapons. The troops fan out quickly, moving toward the large opening blown into the ground—the shattered remains of an octagonal hatch destroyed by the bunker-buster missile. Behind them, the A-10 Warthogs pull away, trailing fire as they lay napalm in the distance. As the soldiers approach the dark hatchway, a surviving Terminator rises from the scorched corn, fires its plasma rifle, and drops one of the fighters. The others return fire with explosive rounds, tearing the machine apart. Their leader signals the group forward, and they rush into the underground passage.
related_events: Choppers land in cornfield and deploy Resistance soldiers

name: Terminator Ambush and Hatchway Breach
description: As the Resistance soldiers move forward through the scorched cornfield, a surviving Terminator rises from the blackened stalks and opens fire with its plasma rifle, striking down one of the soldiers. The others immediately return fire with explosive rounds, their bullets tearing into the machine until it is blown apart. With the robot destroyed, the leader of the assault group raises his weapon and signals for the remaining troops to advance toward the dark opening in the ground, then leads them down into the hatchway.
related_events: Surviving Terminator rises from singed corn and fires plasma rifle
Resistance soldiers fire explosive bullets and destroy Terminator
Assault group leader signals soldiers to enter dark hatchway

name: Arrival at the Service Station
description: The Jeep approaches off-road and comes to a stop at a crumbling service station. Marcus climbs out from behind the wheel and walks over to a rusting tanker sitting on flat tires, its cab long gone. He pounds on the tanker's side, producing a deep, hollow echo. 'Damn it. Empty,' he mutters. Nearby, Star and Kyle raise their binoculars, scanning the surrounding area for any sign of movement or surveillance. Kyle sniffs the air, then asks, 'You smell that?' Star takes a breath, her eyes widening. 'Food!' she says. They both drop their unloaded guns and run toward the garage. High above, behind the rusted remains of a service station sign, an aerostat slowly emerges, its lights blinking as it turns toward them.
related_events: Jeep arrives at crumbling service station
Marcus checks rusting tanker for fuel
Star and Kyle scan area for Skynet surveillance

name: Kyle and Star Detect Food Scent and Rush to Garage
description: Kyle sniffs the air and asks if anyone else smells something. Star takes a breath, her eyes widening as she recognizes the scent. 'Food!' she exclaims. Both she and Kyle jump out of the Jeep, each carrying their unloaded guns, and run toward the garage.
related_events: Kyle detects unusual scent in the air
Star detects scent of food and reacts with excitement
Star and Kyle exit Jeep and run toward garage

name: Aerostat Emerges Behind Rusting Sign
description: As Star and Kyle run toward the garage, a large aerostat drifts into view from behind a rusting sign. It hovers with blinking lights, its sensors trained on the children.
related_events: Aerostat appears behind rusting sign and targets the children

name: Kyle Suggests Finding Daytime Shelter
description: The Jeep pulls to a stop near a crumbling service station with a rusting tanker on flat tires, its cab long gone. Marcus gets out and pounds on the tanker—there’s a deep echo. He curses under his breath. “Empty.” Kyle raises his head, sniffing the air. Star does the same, her eyes widening. “Food!” she says. They both jump out of the Jeep and run toward the garage, carrying their unloaded guns. High above, behind a rusting sign, an aerostat emerges, its lights blinking as it turns toward them.
related_events: Kyle suggests finding shelter for the day

name: Kyle, Star, and Marcus Head Toward Distant Buildings
description: Kyle, Star, and Marcus walk along the roadside, moving toward dark buildings a few hundred yards away near an overpass. The fallen sign 'GAS FOOD LODGING' lies beside the road as they travel. Marcus asks what year it is. Star says seventeen, but Kyle corrects him—eighteen, two thousand eighteen. Marcus says he has lost fifteen years and asks if there was a war, wondering if terrorists, the Russians, or the Chinese started it. Kyle looks at him and says the machines did it—the computers got smart. Star whispers 'Judgment Day' and says she was just a baby. Kyle asks Marcus what the last thing he remembers is. Marcus pauses, then says, 'Dying.'
related_events: Group walks toward dark buildings near overpass

name: Marcus Asks About the Year
description: Kyle, Star, and Marcus walk along the roadside toward dark buildings near an overpass. As they move, Marcus asks what year it is. Star says 'Seventeen,' but Kyle corrects her, saying it's eighteen—two thousand eighteen. Marcus falls silent, then says he's lost fifteen years. He asks if there was a war, wondering if terrorists or the Russians or Chinese started it. Kyle looks at him and asks if something fell on his head. He tells Marcus it wasn't a war—it was the machines, the computers, that turned against them. Star whispers 'Judgment Day,' saying she was just a baby then. Kyle asks Marcus what the last thing he remembers is. Marcus pauses, then says, 'Dying.'
related_events: Marcus questions the current year
Star and Kyle correct the current year

name: Marcus Learns the Year and Questions the Past
description: Kyle, Star, and Marcus walk along the roadside toward dark buildings near an overpass. A fallen sign lies behind them: 'GAS FOOD LODGING.' Marcus asks what year it is. Star says seventeen. Kyle corrects him—eighteen. Two thousand eighteen. Marcus falls silent, then says he has lost fifteen years. He asks if there was a war, if terrorists or the Russians or the Chinese started it, if it was the nukes. Kyle looks at him sideways. Star doesn't understand. Kyle says the machines did it—the computers. They got smart. Judgment Day. Star says he was just a baby then. Kyle asks Marcus what the last thing he remembers is. Marcus pauses. He says, 'Dying.'
related_events: Marcus realizes he has lost fifteen years
Marcus speculates about cause of global catastrophe

name: Kyle Explains the Machine Uprising
description: As they walk along the roadside toward the dark buildings near the overpass, Marcus asks what year it is. Star says seventeen, but Kyle corrects him—eighteen, two thousand eighteen. Marcus grows uneasy, realizing he has lost fifteen years. He wonders if terrorists or a foreign power started a war, if nuclear bombs fell. Kyle looks at him sharply and asks if something hit his head. It wasn’t a war between nations, he says—the machines did it. The computers got smart. Star whispers the words 'Judgment Day,' remembering it from when she was a baby. Kyle turns to Marcus and asks what the last thing he remembers is. Marcus pauses, then says, 'Dying.'
related_events: Kyle reveals machines caused the apocalypse
Star recalls Judgment Day from infancy

name: Marcus Remembers Dying
description: Kyle asks Marcus what the last thing he remembers is. Marcus pauses, then says, 'Dying.'
related_events: Kyle asks Marcus about his last memory
Marcus recalls dying as his last memory

name: Regroup at the Jeep After Patrol
description: The aerostat finishes scanning the motel area and moves away on its patrol. Moments later, the van door slides open. Marcus steps out, followed by Kyle and Star. They move quickly across the dusty lot to the abandoned Jeep Wrangler with its hood up. Marcus returns to working on the engine, spark plugs and distributor parts laid out beside him. Kyle picks up a bicycle pump and begins inflating one of the flat tires. Star glances at her watch, then wipes dust from the side of the van, revealing a painted white unicorn in a field of flowers.
related_events: Aerostat conducts surveillance over motel area and scans abandoned vehicles
Marcus, Kyle, and Star emerge from van and return to jeep

name: Marcus Repairs Jeep Engine While Kyle Inflates Tire
description: Marcus crouched under the hood of the old Jeep Wrangler, removing and cleaning the spark plugs before taking apart the distributor. He worked with tools he had found nearby, moving with familiarity. Beside him, Kyle knelt at one of the tires, pumping air into it with a bicycle pump. The tire slowly expanded as he pushed the handle up and down. Dust covered the vehicles, and the air was still, broken only by the rhythmic sound of the pump and the occasional clink of metal as Marcus adjusted parts under the engine.
related_events: Marcus inspects and repairs jeep engine components
Kyle inflates tire using bicycle pump

name: Star Reveals Van Art, Marcus Remembers Unicorns
description: Star wipes the dirt from the side of the customized van, revealing airbrushed artwork of a white unicorn standing in a field of flowers. Marcus looks up from working on the Jeep’s engine, sees the image, and smiles. He says, "Not too many around in my time."
related_events: Star cleans dirt from van to reveal airbrushed artwork
Marcus recalls scarcity of unicorns in his time

name: Kyle Asks Marcus to Teach Him to Drive
description: KYLE pumps air into one of the jeep's flat tires using a bicycle pump. Nearby, MARCUS works on the engine of the old JEEP WRANGLER, cleaning spark plugs and dismantling the distributor. As he works, KYLE asks if Marcus will teach him how to make the vehicle go if they get it running. Marcus looks up, pauses briefly, then replies, "It's called driving. Sure."
related_events: Kyle asks Marcus to teach him how to drive

name: Star Checks the Time While Watching the Surroundings
description: Star checks her watch as she follows Marcus and Kyle. She looks around, taking in the area, then wipes dirt from the side of the van to reveal painted artwork beneath—a white unicorn in a field of flowers.
related_events: Star checks her watch while monitoring surroundings

name: Barnes Restores Power in the Underground Crash Pad
description: In the dark, the sound of crying babies and muttered curses fills the air. A match strikes, lighting a candle held by Barnes, a young man in his twenties. He yawns, his expression annoyed, and pulls the blanket off the two women beside him, ignoring their protests. Wrapping the blanket around himself, he steps carefully past sleeping bodies scattered across the floor, candle in hand, making his way toward a metal staircase. He descends, the candlelight flickering against the walls. Moments later, a gas engine roars to life. Overhead, lights flicker and come on, illuminating the grimy interior of the underground crash pad. On a bank of TV monitors, Marcus and Blair appear, shouting silently, their figures frozen on the screen.
related_events: Barnes is awakened and expresses annoyance
Barnes removes blanket from bedmates and wraps himself
Barnes carries candle past sleeping figures toward staircase
Generator is started and lights flicker on
related_occasions: Communal Living Gathering In Underground Crash Pad

name: Lisa Sees Figures on the Monitor
description: The bank of TV monitors flickers to life in the dim underground crash pad. Lisa moves toward the screens, squinting at one in particular. On it, Marcus and Blair stand in place, their faces strained, mouths open in silent cries. She steps back, alarmed. 'We got company!' she calls out. The room stirs, sleepers shifting, children whimpering, as the figures on the screen continue to shout, unheard.
related_events: Match is lit to illuminate dark room
Bank of TV monitors comes to life in underground crash pad
Lisa notices approaching figures on monitor screen
Lisa alerts others about incoming company
Marcus and Blair cry out from outside, unheard
related_occasions: Communal Living Gathering In Underground Crash Pad

name: Women Tend to Crying Babies in Nursery
description: In the dim light, two women rise from the main sleeping area and move across the room to the nursery. They kneel beside the infants, lifting them from their makeshift beds, soothing them with quiet murmurs, adjusting blankets, and checking their needs as the generator hums and the monitors glow in the background.
related_events: Two women move to nursery area to care for babies
related_occasions: Communal Living Gathering In Underground Crash Pad

name: Barnes Lights a Candle and Starts the Generator
description: In the dark, a match flares to life, casting light across the grimy underground crash pad. Babies cry from nearby, and figures shift under blankets. Barnes, a young man in his twenties, yawns and mutters as he lights a candle. He pulls the blanket off the women beside him, ignoring their protests, and wraps it around himself. Holding the candle, he steps carefully around sleeping bodies toward a metal staircase. He descends, and moments later, a gas engine sputters and roars to life. Overhead, lights flicker on, illuminating the room’s military remnants, including a bank of TV monitors now glowing on the wall. One of the women, Lisa, moves toward the monitors and stares at a screen, where two figures—Marcus and Blair—shout silently, their faces strained with exhaustion.
related_events: Match is lit to illuminate dark room
related_occasions: Communal Living Gathering In Underground Crash Pad

name: Priest Recites Scripture as Marcus Smokes in Silence
description: A priest sits beside Marcus Wright's cot, holding a Bible and reciting scripture. Marcus lies on his cot, staring at the ceiling, smoking a cigarette. He takes a slow drag and blows a cloud of smoke in the priest's direction. The priest blinks, closes the Bible, and remains seated as two guards wait by the door, shackles in hand. The cell is quiet except for the faint sound of breathing and distant echoes from the corridor.
related_events: Priest recites scripture beside Marcus Wright's cot
Marcus Wright stares at the ceiling while smoking a cigarette
Marcus Wright blows smoke toward the priest

name: Dr. Kogan Enters Marcus's Cell
description: The guard unlocks the cell door, allowing Dr. Serena Kogan to enter. She steps inside, clipboard in hand, as the priest closes his Bible and moves away from Marcus's cot, giving them space. Marcus remains seated on his cot, watching as the priest retreats and Dr. Kogan approaches.
related_events: Guard unlocks cell door for Dr. Serena Kogan
Priest steps back to give privacy to Marcus and Dr. Kogan

name: Dr. Kogan Secures Marcus's Consent for Project Angel
description: Dr. Serena Kogan enters Marcus Wright's cell carrying a clipboard. She tells him he has been chosen for Project Angel and reminds him that he previously consented to donate his body to science. Marcus sits up, takes the clipboard and pen she offers, and notices her hands trembling. He asks if she is afraid, and she replies that the shaking is due to nerve degeneration. He glances at the scarf covering her head and asks if she has cancer; she nods. Marcus signs the form with a sarcastic remark about being a hero. Dr. Kogan takes the clipboard back, thanks him, and briefly touches his hand before leaving. A guard escorts her out of the cell.
related_events: Dr. Serena Kogan enters Marcus Wright's cell with a clipboard
Dr. Serena Kogan explains Project Angel to Marcus Wright
Marcus Wright signs the Project Angel consent form

name: Marcus and Dr. Kogan Share a Moment of Truth
description: Marcus notices Dr. Kogan's hands trembling as she hands him the clipboard. He asks if she is scared, and she replies that she is not, explaining that the shaking is due to nerve degeneration. He looks at her more closely, noticing the scarf covering her head, and asks if she has cancer. She nods. Marcus falls silent for a moment, then meets her eyes. She tells him his participation in the project is important, that their work is experimental but could help people in ways he cannot imagine. He signs the form with a sarcastic remark about being a hero. She takes the clipboard, starts to leave, then pauses and touches his hand. 'Thank you,' she says. 'And... I'm sorry.' He replies, 'No one lives forever.' A guard steps forward and escorts her out of the cell.
related_events: Marcus Wright notices Dr. Serena Kogan's shaking hands
Dr. Serena Kogan reveals her terminal illness to Marcus Wright
Dr. Serena Kogan thanks Marcus Wright and expresses sympathy

name: Marcus Approaches the Collapsed Newsstand
description: Marcus moves toward a collapsed newsstand in the ruined city. He steps past the broken racks and reaches for a magazine, but it disintegrates in his hands. Behind the counter, a human skeleton lies half-buried in the debris, tattered clothing clinging to its bones.
related_events: Marcus approaches a collapsed newsstand
Marcus attempts to pick up a magazine that crumbles
Marcus discovers a human skeleton behind the counter

name: Marcus Finds Cigarettes and a Lighter
description: Marcus crouched beside the half-buried skeleton behind the collapsed newsstand. He reached into the tattered shirt pocket and pulled out a cellophane-wrapped pack of cigarettes and a butane lighter. He sat down on a nearby chunk of rubble, tore open the packet, and placed a dried cigarette between his lips. He flicked the lighter several times before a flame appeared, then lit the cigarette and inhaled deeply. He waited, then took a few more slow drags, exhaled, and finally flicked the cigarette into the snow. He stood and turned toward a caved-in storefront, its broken sign lying among the glass shards.
related_events: Marcus retrieves cigarettes and a lighter from the skeleton's pocket
Marcus sits by the skeleton on a piece of rubble

name: Marcus Tries to Smoke a Cigarette
description: Marcus tears open the cellophane packet and pulls out a dried cigarette. He flicks the butane lighter several times until a flame catches. Holding the flame to the tip, he lights the cigarette and inhales deeply, pausing as if waiting for something. He takes a few more slow drags, his expression unchanged, then flicks the cigarette into the snow. It lands silently, smoldering briefly before the wind snuffs it out.
related_events: Marcus opens the cigarette packet and attempts to light a cigarette
Marcus inhales the cigarette and feels no effect
Marcus discards the cigarette in disappointment

name: Marcus Notices the Clothing Store Sign
description: Marcus flicks the cigarette away and rises from the rubble. He looks toward a caved-in storefront and sees a tattered sign lying among broken glass. The sign reads 'SALE! GOING OUT OF BUSINESS! EVERYTHING MUST GO!'
related_events: Marcus notices a tattered clothing store sign among broken glass

name: Marcus Drinks Snow for Water
description: Marcus moves down the ruined block, his breath visible in the cold air. He stops, crouches, and scoops a handful of snow from the ground. He brings it slowly to his lips, letting it melt in his mouth before swallowing.
related_events: Marcus collects snow and brings it to his lips

name: Star Finds Marcus by the Door
description: Star opens the door and steps out, pausing when she sees Marcus sitting against the wall, the shotgun beside him, his head bowed over a bible. He is still, eyes closed, asleep. She exhales, her shoulders relaxing, and takes a step toward him. The movement startles him—he jerks awake, blinking rapidly. She says, 'Just me.' He recognizes her, his posture softening. She sits down beside him.
related_events: Star steps out of the room and sees Marcus
Marcus wakes up startled as Star approaches

name: Marcus Reads from the Phonebook
description: Marcus sits with the bible open in his lap, eyes closed, asleep. The door behind him opens and Star steps out, pausing when she sees him. He startles awake. She reassures him, saying it's just her, and sits beside him. She asks what he's reading. He tells her it's the bible, admits it always put him to sleep, and flips to a random page. At her request, he reads aloud: 'Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori. Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh—' Star interrupts, remembering a book with pictures. She gets up and returns with a phonebook. Marcus sets the bible aside and begins reading from the phonebook: 'Guaranteed lowest prices... open seven days...' Star looks over his shoulder as he turns the pages. She points to an image. He tells her it's a rose. She wonders if the numbers could be used to get flowers, or have someone come fix things, or bring food. Marcus nods, flipping through. He lists what else is there—movers, mufflers, music. Star asks about music. He hums a few lines from different songs, but she doesn't recognize any—until he sings 'Twinkle twinkle little star.' Her face brightens. She joins in, singing the next lines with him. When the song ends, she wipes her eye, turns away. He asks if she's okay. She shakes her head, says someone used to sing that to her. He sets the phonebook down, places a hand on her arm. She leans into him, and they hug as she begins to cry. He stays.
related_events: Marcus reads a random passage from the bible
Star asks Marcus to read something to her
Star finds a phonebook with pictures
Marcus reads from the phonebook instead of the bible

name: Star Learns About the Phonebook and Hears a Familiar Song
description: Marcus sits with the phonebook open in his lap, reading entries aloud. Star leans over his shoulder, watching as he turns the pages. She points to a picture and asks what it is. Marcus tells her it's a rose. Her eyes widen as she realizes the numbers in the book could be used to call for flowers, repairs, or food. She marvels at the idea, speaking softly about how people once had such things. Marcus flips through more pages, listing what else might be found—movers, mufflers, music. At the word 'music,' Star grows curious. Marcus tries to jog her memory with a few songs, but she doesn't recognize them. Then he begins to sing, 'Twinkle twinkle little star.' Star's face lights up. She joins in, singing the words with him. When the song ends, she wipes a tear from her eye and turns away, quietly saying someone used to sing that to her. Marcus sets the book aside and puts a hand on her arm. She leans into him, and he holds her as she begins to cry.
related_events: Star points to an image and asks about a rose
Marcus sings "Twinkle twinkle little star" to Star

name: Marcus Sings 'Twinkle Twinkle Little Star' with Star
description: Marcus flips through the phonebook, reading off entries like 'movers,' 'mufflers,' and 'music.' Star asks about music, and Marcus tries to recall songs, humming 'I can't get no satisfaction' and 'We are family,' but Star doesn't recognize them. Then he begins singing 'Twinkle twinkle little star.' Star's face lights up. She nods eagerly and sings along. When the song ends, she is overwhelmed, her eyes filling with tears. She turns away, wiping one eye, and says softly that someone used to sing that to her. Marcus sets the phonebook aside and puts a hand on her arm. She leans into him, and they hug.
related_events: Star recognizes and sings along to "Twinkle twinkle little star"
Star becomes emotional and recalls someone singing to her

name: Star Asks Marcus to Stay
description: After singing 'Twinkle twinkle little star' together, Star becomes overwhelmed, her eyes filling with tears. She turns away briefly, then looks at Marcus and asks him to stay with them. Marcus sets the phonebook aside, places a hand on her arm, and pulls her into a hug. She leans into him, holding on as he holds her.
related_events: Marcus comforts Star with a hug
Star pleads with Marcus to stay with them

name: Defend the River Crossing from Aerial Attack
description: On the far bank of the river, concrete bunkers and anti-aircraft guns opened fire as an A-10 approached. Blue plasma bursts arced through the air, striking the aircraft’s wing and tearing through the metal. The damaged wing gave way, sending the A-10 into a violent spin. It plummeted, out of control, as the second A-10 broke off its dogfight with a Harvester and veered away from the river, retreating into the distance.
related_events: Anti-aircraft guns fire plasma volley at approaching A-10
Plasma fire destroys A-10 wing causing loss of control
Damaged A-10 spins out of control after wing destruction
Second A-10 breaks off dogfight and retreats from river area

name: Marcus Falls from the Harvester
description: Marcus climbs the dead Harvester attached to the side of the transport, struggling against the force of the engine blast. He reaches toward the upper edge of the transport, fingers nearly grasping the rim, when the Harvester suddenly detaches from the engine pod. The machine and Marcus plummet together, tumbling into freefall. He drops toward the earth, the transport speeding away above him, crossing the river. The ground and treetops rush up in his view. At the last moment, his forward motion carries him over the river’s edge. Marcus and the Harvester strike the water hard, vanishing beneath the surface in a violent splash.
related_events: Marcus attempts to climb dead Harvester while avoiding engine blast
Fried Harvester dislodges from engine pod taking Marcus into freefall

name: Marcus Falls into the River with the Harvester
description: After the fried Harvester detaches from the engine pod, Marcus is pulled into freefall. He plummets toward the ground, his forward motion carrying him over the river. He and the Harvester strike the water hard, disappearing beneath the surface in a series of massive splashes.
related_events: Marcus and dead Harvester impact river surface after freefall

name: The Transport Crosses Into Skynet Territory
description: The surviving Hunter-Killer and the transport press forward, crossing the river into Skynet-controlled territory. They move steadily beyond the far bank, where concrete bunkers and anti-aircraft guns line the shore, and vanish into the distance. Marcus is no longer with them.
related_events: Surviving H-K and transport continue across river into Skynet territory

name: Parachute Drifts to Riverbank
description: A parachute drifts downward through the air, landing on the unfortified side of the river. It touches down near the water's edge, the fabric settling as the wind dies.
related_events: Parachute descends on unfortified side of river

name: The Jeep Escape Begins
description: Marcus and Kyle push the Jeep from the carport, the tires partially inflated, as Star sits behind the wheel with the seat moved all the way up. They guide the vehicle to a slight slope where it begins to roll on its own. Marcus shouts for Star to pop the clutch. Her foot releases the clutch pedal and the engine sputters violently before catching. The tape deck erupts with distorted heavy metal music, the cassette speeding and slowing erratically. Marcus sprints toward the driver's side, but the Jeep gains speed quickly. Star stares at the speaker, transfixed by the sound, until she realizes they're heading toward a wall and lets out a scream. Marcus vaults into the driver's seat, shoves her aside, slams on the brakes, and shifts into neutral. Kyle jumps into the back just as Marcus adjusts the seat and floors the accelerator.
related_events: Jeep is pushed from carport to initiate escape
Star attempts to start hot-wired Jeep

name: Marcus Takes Control to Avoid Crash
description: The Jeep lurches forward as the tape deck erupts with heavy metal music, the sound speeding and slowing erratically. Star stares at the speaker, frozen, until she sees the wall rushing toward her. She screams, but before impact, Marcus vaults into the driver’s side, shoves her aside, and slams on the brakes, throwing the Jeep into neutral. The vehicle shudders to a stop, just short of the wall.
related_events: Heavy metal music blares from Jeep's tape deck
Marcus vaults into Jeep and takes control
Star nearly crashes Jeep into wall

name: Escape Across the Plains and Confront the Aerostat
description: Marcus slammed his foot on the gas, sending the Jeep lurching forward as it tore across the open plains, lights off and music blaring from the tape deck. Star sat wide-eyed, still caught in the rush of sound and motion, while Kyle scanned the dark sky from the back. The vehicle bounced over rough terrain, gaining speed. Then Marcus looked up, his expression shifting. He reached over and turned the music down. Above them, the Aerostat hovered, red lights flashing, keeping pace with the Jeep as it glided silently through the night air.
related_events: Marcus floors Jeep to escape aerostat
Marcus drives Jeep off-road across the plains with music loud and lights off
Marcus turns down the music upon spotting the Aerostat overhead

name: Marcus Stops the Jeep and Confronts the Aerostat
description: The Aerostat hovered above the Jeep, red lights flashing as it kept pace with the vehicle. Kyle climbed up in the back and swung the shotgun butt at it, but the Aerostat dodged each strike. Marcus slammed on the brakes, bringing the Jeep to a sudden stop just feet from the hovering machine, which remained suspended in the air ahead of them.
related_events: Aerostat hovers above Jeep with flashing red lights and tracks the vehicle
Kyle attacks Aerostat with shotgun butt but fails to hit
Marcus slams brakes to stop Jeep in front of hovering Aerostat

name: Marcus Destroys the Aerostat
description: Marcus grabbed an X-shaped lug wrench from behind his seat, rose up in the Jeep, and hurled it at the hovering Aerostat. The wrench spun through the air and struck the machine with tremendous force, smashing it into pieces that rained down in sparks and metal shards. The Jeep fell silent. Kyle, wide-eyed, looked at Marcus and said, 'Wow. You're good.' Marcus flexed his hand, staring at it, visibly surprised by what he had just done.
related_events: Marcus throws lug wrench at Aerostat and destroys it
Three characters react in stunned silence after Aerostat is destroyed
Kyle compliments Marcus on his accuracy and strength
Marcus reacts with surprise to his own physical capability

name: Blair Trips, Marcus Catches Her in the Dark
description: Marcus and Blair move carefully through the darkness, the moon having set. As they navigate the uneven ground, Blair trips, and Marcus catches her before she falls. They continue on, the moment passing without comment, but the closeness lingers as they press forward in the dim light.
related_events: Blair trips and Marcus catches her

name: Decide to Wait Until Morning and Share Warmth
description: The moon has set, and the forest is dark. Blair stumbles as they move, but Marcus catches her before she falls. She thanks him, then sighs, yawns, and sits against a tree. 'It's not far, but we'll never get across the minefield at night. Might as well staf till morning,' she says. Marcus nods and sits a few feet away. 'C'mere, it's cold. I don't bite,' Blair says. Marcus slides closer. She nestles against him, resting her head on his chest. His hand moves into his pocket, and she follows it, pulling out scraps of paper with women's faces drawn on them. 'What are these?' she asks, squinting at them in the dark. 'I dunno. They just... sorta reminded me of her,' he says. 'Who?' 'There's a woman—the last woman I saw before I went under. She kept coming to me. I think she must've saved me.' Blair is quiet, then closes her eyes. Marcus stares up into the darkness.
related_events: Blair suggests waiting until morning
Marcus sits near Blair and moves closer at her invitation

name: Marcus and Blair Share a Kiss
description: Blair nestles against Marcus, and they begin to kiss passionately. The closeness deepens between them, but suddenly Marcus pulls away, rolling onto his back and breaking the moment. The intimacy falters as he withdraws, leaving the space between them charged with unspoken tension.
related_events: Marcus and Blair kiss passionately
Marcus pulls away from the kiss and lies on his back

name: Blair Explains the Meaning of 'Staf'
description: Blair sits against a tree, shivering in the cold. Marcus slides closer, and she nestles against him. When he asks what 'staf' means, she tells him it's a resistance term—a mix of waiting and intimacy. The word lingers between them as they stay close, sharing warmth in the dark.
related_events: Blair explains the meaning of 'staf'

name: Blair Finds the Paper Scraps and Marcus Speaks of the Woman from His Past
description: Blair slips a hand into Marcus's pocket for warmth and pulls out scraps of paper with women's faces drawn or printed on them. She squints at them in the dim light, asking what they are. Marcus says he doesn't know, only that they reminded him of her—the woman he saw just before he was frozen. He recalls that she kept appearing to him during the dead time, and he believes she might have saved him. Blair falls quiet, closes her eyes, and rests her head against his chest. Marcus stays awake, staring up into the dark.
related_events: Blair finds scraps of paper with women's faces in Marcus's pocket
Marcus explains the significance of the woman he remembers from before being frozen

name: Blair Rests Against Marcus as He Stares Into the Dark
description: Blair closes her eyes and rests her head against Marcus's chest, settling into silence. Marcus lies awake, staring up into the darkness without speaking.
related_events: Blair expresses insecurity about competing with Marcus's memory of the woman
Marcus stares into the darkness while Blair rests against him

name: Marcus Watches the Children Sleep and Hears Their Story
description: Marcus stands in the dim room, looking at his reflection in a cracked mirror, then turns to watch Kyle and Star. The room is cluttered with graffiti, trash scattered across the floor, the remains of other squatters long gone. Star lies on the bare bed, already asleep after yawning and closing the tattered curtains. Kyle sits in front of the TV, scratching stick figures into the screen with a rusted pocketknife—one figure clearly himself, the other a smaller one wearing a baseball cap, representing Star. He asks Marcus if he ever watched television. Marcus says he did, especially during his time in prison. Star, half-awake, asks what a prison is, and Marcus tells her it's where he spent half his life. Kyle remembers cartoons and says TV was great. He lies down beside Star. Marcus asks if she's Kyle's sister. Kyle says he doesn't know—they've been together since they were little, the only two left from a group of kids at a daycare when the bombs fell. Marcus looks around the ruined room. Kyle tells him they're going to find the Resistance, fight for John Connor against Skynet, and invites Marcus to join. Marcus questions who John Connor is. Kyle says he's the one who's going to save them all. Marcus mutters a skeptical remark, comparing him to Jesus. Kyle, not knowing who Jesus is, asks why Marcus was in prison. After a pause, Marcus says he killed a cop. He explains that his younger brother Max had stolen a car, was already in cuffs, but the officer kept beating him. Marcus ran out, the cop went for his gun, and Marcus attacked him, breaking his neck. He doesn't remember much of it. He assumes Max is dead now, like everyone else. He notices Kyle has fallen asleep, speaking to him as if telling a bedtime story. Marcus is quiet for a moment, then gently pulls a cover over both children. Kyle stirs slightly and asks, without opening his eyes, if Marcus will still be there when he wakes. Marcus says yes. Kyle tells him to stay away from the windows, then drifts back to sleep. Marcus sighs, moves through the room, and quietly opens a drawer, finding a Bible inside.
related_events: Marcus observes his reflection in a cracked mirror
Kyle shares origin story of survival after nuclear attack
Kyle invites Marcus to join the Resistance
Kyle expresses faith in John Connor as humanity's savior

name: Marcus Tells Kyle About Killing a Cop
description: Kyle asks Marcus why he was in prison. Marcus pauses, then tells him he killed a cop. He describes how his younger brother Max stole a car and was caught in their front yard. The officer pulled Max from the vehicle, put him in cuffs, but kept beating him. Marcus ran out to stop it. The cop drew his gun, and Marcus attacked him, breaking his neck. He says he doesn’t remember doing it. He wonders aloud if Max is dead now, like everyone else. As Marcus speaks, Kyle grows drowsy and falls asleep. Marcus notices, falls silent, and gently pulls a cover over Kyle and Star on the bed. Kyle stirs slightly, half-awake, and asks if Marcus will still be there when he wakes up. Marcus says yes. Kyle tells him to stay away from the windows, then drifts back to sleep. Marcus sighs, moves quietly around the room, and opens a drawer. Inside, he finds a Bible.
related_events: Marcus reveals his history of incarceration
Marcus recounts killing a police officer during a confrontation
Marcus discovers Kyle has fallen asleep while sharing his story

name: Kyle Asks About Jesus
description: Marcus mentions Jesus in passing, with a tone of sarcasm. Kyle, lying on the bed and half-asleep, asks who Jesus is. Marcus looks at him, then replies that Kyle is asking the wrong guy. Later, after putting a cover over Kyle and Star, Marcus quietly opens a drawer and finds a Bible inside.
related_events: Marcus questions the identity of John Connor
Kyle asks Marcus about Jesus

name: Marcus Covers the Children and Finds a Bible
description: After Kyle asks if Marcus will still be there when he wakes up, Marcus assures him he will. Kyle drifts back to sleep. Marcus sighs, moves quietly through the room, and gently pulls a cover over both children. He then opens a drawer, rummages through it, and finds a Bible.
related_events: Marcus discovers Kyle has fallen asleep while sharing his story
Kyle asks Marcus to stay upon waking and warns him about the windows
Marcus searches drawers and finds a Bible

name: Kyle Scratches Stick Figures, Star Goes to Sleep
description: As night falls, Star closes the tattered curtains and lies down on the bare bed, quickly drifting to sleep. Kyle sits in front of the television, using a rusted pocketknife to scratch stick figures into the screen. One figure is taller, representing himself; the other, smaller and wearing a baseball cap, represents Star.
related_events: Star closes curtains and lies down to sleep
Kyle scratches stick figures into television screen

name: Blair's Landing and Rescue by Marcus
description: Blair Williams ejects from her aircraft and lands tangled in the branches of a tree, suspended above the ground by her parachute. As she struggles to cut herself free with a knife, the lines suddenly snap and she falls. Marcus moves quickly, catching her in mid-air before she hits the ground. He sets her down gently, and introduces himself. Blair removes her helmet, checks her compass, and begins to move out, shaken but unharmed.
related_events: Blair Williams ejects from her aircraft and lands in the trees
Marcus catches Blair after her parachute lines snap

name: Blair Orients Marcus and Proposes a Route to Safety
description: Blair pulls off her helmet, her short hair revealed as she reaches into her flight suit and pulls out a compass. She studies it briefly, getting her bearings. She tells Marcus there's an outpost a few miles upriver they can head to, though she doesn't trust the people there. She warns him the river is filled with hydrobots that can't see but detect movement and sound with sonar, making crossing impossible. She adds that the area ahead is a hot zone, saturated with radiation all the way to the Gulf coast, deadly to anyone who enters. Marcus points across the water, saying he needs to reach his friends. Blair looks at him, incredulous, and reminds him the transport was headed into a Skynet-controlled zone. She identifies herself as Lieutenant Blair Williams, a pilot for what used to be the Air National Guard, part of the Resistance. She urges him to come with her to the outpost.
related_events: Blair consults her compass to determine direction
Blair reveals the presence of hydrobots in the river
Blair warns Marcus about radiation in the hot zone
Blair identifies herself as a Resistance pilot

name: Marcus Chooses to Follow Blair to the Outpost
description: Marcus stands by the riverbank, looking toward the opposite shore where his friends were taken. Blair warns him of the dangers—hydrobots in the water with sonar that detect movement and sound, radiation spreading for miles, and the constant threat of terminators. He hesitates, then turns away from the river and begins walking alongside Blair. They move through the trees, putting distance between themselves and the patrol area, following her lead toward the outpost upriver.
related_events: Marcus decides to join Blair and move toward the outpost

name: Blair and Marcus Evade T-1 Patrol
description: Blair spots two T-1 robots patrolling nearby and signals Marcus to take cover behind a fallen tree. The machines roll closer, scanning the area with their weapons ready. Without a word, Blair grabs a stone, stays low, and hurls it into the trees. The stone clatters through the branches, drawing the T-1s’ attention. They immediately open fire on the sound, tearing through foliage and igniting small fires with their incendiary rounds. Once the robots move toward the disturbance to investigate, Blair and Marcus slip away from their hiding place and continue on their path, moving quietly through the woods.
related_events: Blair signals Marcus to hide behind a fallen tree upon spotting T-1s
T-1s patrol the area and scan for movement near Blair and Marcus
Blair throws a stone to distract the T-1s
T-1s open fire on the area where the stone landed
Blair and Marcus move away from their hiding place after the distraction

name: Blair Punches Marcus to Prove Reality
description: As they move away from the area, Marcus says the events might be a dream or a hallucination, something that happens right before death. Without hesitation, Blair punches him hard in the arm. He doesn’t flinch, only looks at her, surprised. She asks if that snapped him out of it. He shakes his head. She mutters a sarcastic remark, telling him to do them a favor and wake up already.
related_events: Marcus expresses disbelief about the reality of the situation
Blair punches Marcus to challenge his disbelief
Blair mocks Marcus's possible dream state

name: Kyle, Star, and Marcus Hide from an Aerostat in an Abandoned Taco Place
description: The group crouches behind an upended table inside what was once a taco place, surrounded by remnants of Mexican decor. Through a dirty window, they watch as an Aerostat buzzes past, moving slowly along its patrol route. It passes without spotting them and disappears into the distance. Marcus rises and watches the window as Kyle explains that the device is one of Skynet's surveillance units, always searching for survivors. With the immediate threat gone, Kyle and Star resume searching the space—rifling through trash cans, checking behind counters, and scavenging in the kitchen. description: Marcus walks alone down the center of a deserted freeway under a moonlit sky, surrounded by flat, treeless plains and the rusted hulks of abandoned cars. In the distance, figures approach from the opposite direction, moving through the darkness. He hurries toward them, waving and calling out, relieved to see what he believes are other survivors. As he draws closer, the figures stop and turn in unison. He freezes. Their faces are identical, expressionless, and made of plastic. Red light flickers in their eyes as they scan him. Armed with plasma rifles and wearing mismatched clothing, they stand motionless. Marcus stumbles back, then turns and runs. The T-400s watch him flee but do not fire.

name: Boy Spots Marcus and Calls Out
description: Perched on the supports of a freeway sign, a scrawny teenage boy watches through a binocular mask as Marcus sprints across the open freeway under the moonlight. The boy mutters, 'Hey mister, where you goin' in such a hurry?' He quickly scrambles down from the sign and steps into Marcus's path as the man slows near an off-ramp.
related_events: Boy observes Marcus through binocular mask and questions him

name: Boy confronts Marcus and examines paper images
description: As Marcus slows to leave the freeway at an off-ramp, the boy steps out from behind rubble, holding a handgun in one hand and a lit oil lantern in the other. He demands food. Marcus raises his hands and says he has none. The boy eyes him skeptically, sets down the lantern, and frisks Marcus with one hand while keeping the gun trained on him. He pulls a handful of paper scraps from Marcus' pocket. Holding them up in the lantern light, he studies the images—fragments of women's faces from a poster, a magazine ad, and a paperback cover—his expression a mix of confusion and curiosity.

name: Marcus Disarms the Boy and Demands Answers
description: Marcus suddenly grabs the boy's gun hand, wrenches it hard, and disarms him as the handgun fires into the air. He takes hold of the weapon and wraps one arm around the boy's throat, holding him tightly. In a desperate voice, Marcus demands to know where he is, saying he thought he was in hell. The boy, struggling under the chokehold, manages to choke out a single word: 'Texas.'

name: Girl with Shotgun Confronts Marcus in Freeway Standoff
description: A younger girl steps out from the shadows behind Marcus, gripping a loaded shotgun and aiming it at his head. She demands he let the boy go. In response, Marcus tightens his grip on the boy and presses the handgun against his cheek. The girl holds her ground, her hands steady despite the tension in her voice. The boy, struggling in Marcus’s hold, tells her to do as Marcus says. He calls her 'Star' and urges her to put the shotgun down, but she hesitates, her finger near the trigger, eyes locked on Marcus. After a tense moment, she begins to lower the weapon.

name: Marcus Overpowers the Children and Uncovers the Empty Guns
description: The girl aims the shotgun at Marcus, a slight smile on her face. Marcus kicks the oil lantern toward her, sending burning oil splashing across her. The fire catches her clothing, and she stumbles, dropping the shotgun as she tries to beat out the flames. Marcus hurls the boy into her, knocking them both to the ground. He grabs the shotgun from the dirt and stands over them, holding both the handgun and the shotgun. The boy scrambles to help the girl put out the fire on her clothes. Marcus checks the chambers of both weapons and finds them empty. Nearby, his photographs lie scattered and burning. He kneels to gather them. The girl, her clothes smudged and singed, asks where the pictures came from. Marcus tells her they came from the city. She demands he return her gun. Marcus gestures for her to pick it up.

name: Hunter-Killer Passes, Children Rescue Marcus
description: A roving Hunter-Killer moves through the dark wasteland, its spotlight sweeping the ground. The beam catches the burning oil from a fallen lantern, and the machine opens fire with blue energy pulses. The boy and girl drop behind a debris wall, pulling Marcus down with them just as the shots explode nearby. Marcus stares in shock as the machine passes, realizing it is not a helicopter but something far more dangerous. Once the threat has passed, the boy introduces himself as Kyle Reese. He gives his name in return—Marcus Wright. The girl, named Star, stands back, watching him with suspicion, but waves weakly when prompted. Kyle suggests they find shelter before dawn. As they rise to leave, Star hesitates, questioning why they should trust him. Kyle shrugs and says he likes him. Without a word, Marcus falls into step behind them as they head across the open plain toward distant buildings.
